COLDWAR_IRQ_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_seed_starting_spirits = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_initialized
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = literacy_rate }
				}
				set_variable = { literacy_rate = 0.35 }
				set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0 }
				update_literacy_rate = yes
				EDU_learn_your_ABCs_with_dread = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_IRQ_record_incumbent = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = { array = global.literacy_rate_nation value = THIS }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.literacy_rate_nation = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = literacy_rate
				NOT = { has_country_flag = education_mechanic }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = EDU_cleared_previously }
			}
			EDU_learn_your_ABCs_with_dread = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_IRQ_1970_focus }
			}
			load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_IRQ_1970_focus
		}
		COLDWAR_IRQ_repair_completed_focus_metadata = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_audit_revision = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_migrate_direct_rewards_v3 = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_audit_upgrade_quotes = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_direct_reward_quotes_v3 = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_initialize = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_political_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_decision_tick = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_current_civilian_capacity = num_of_civilian_factories }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_IRQ_civilian_capacity_peak }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civilian_capacity_peak = COLDWAR_IRQ_current_civilian_capacity }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_current_civilian_capacity value = COLDWAR_IRQ_civilian_capacity_peak compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civilian_capacity_peak = COLDWAR_IRQ_current_civilian_capacity }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_participation
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_damaged_buildings = yes
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_current_civilian_capacity value = COLDWAR_IRQ_civilian_capacity_peak compare = less_than }
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reconstruction_need
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = PER }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_first_war_seen }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_first_war_seen
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_campaign_window_open days = 30 value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_current_war_start }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_current_war_start
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_current_war_start days > 179 }
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_attrition_bill }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_attrition_bill
			}
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_current_war_start
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_campaign_window_open
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_attrition_bill
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_opening_offensive
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_sustained_offensive
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_iran_followup_offensive
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				399 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_khuzestan_hold_since }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_khuzestan_hold_since
			}
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_khuzestan_hold_since }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}
